rules.sql: SELECT p.business_unit, p.settlement_date, r.resolved_value_date, r.status, r.row_count, r.requested_at, p.published_at FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = p.published_run_id WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING')

WITH run AS ( SELECT r.resolved_value_date AS v_date FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = p.published_run_id WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), base AS ( SELECT c.trade_id::text AS trade_id, c.security_id, c.transaction_date, c.netting_status, c.netting_date, c.reset_status, c.reset_date, c.subportfolio, c.portfolio, CASE WHEN c.trade_id::text LIKE 'NET-%' THEN 'NET-' WHEN c.trade_id::text LIKE 'DUP-%' THEN 'DUP-' ELSE 'normal' END AS trade_kind FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.is_latest_version = 1 ), lal AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.latest_active_lot l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = :bu ), fy AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.premium_fy_table p JOIN opera.valuation_financial_year_view v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = p.business_unit AND v.financial_year = p.financial_year WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu ), vdt AS ( SELECT max(value_date) AS v_max FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu ), bar AS ( SELECT bmt.security_id, max(bmt.isbarrier1_breached) AS b1 FROM opera.barrier_monitoring_table bmt, vdt WHERE bmt.tenant_id = :tenant AND bmt.business_unit = :bu AND bmt.value_date <= vdt.v_max GROUP BY bmt.security_id ), sec AS ( SELECT s0.security_id, s0.maturity_date, s0.derivative_type FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s0 WHERE s0.tenant_id = :tenant AND s0.business_unit = :bu ), snap AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.trade_id::text LIKE '%-' || CAST(:bu AS text) THEN left(x.trade_id::text, length(x.trade_id::text) - length(CAST(:bu AS text)) - 1) ELSE x.trade_id::text END AS trade_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu AND x.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), t AS ( SELECT b.trade_id, b.trade_kind, b.netting_status, (l.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS in_lal, (b.transaction_date < r.v_date AND (CAST(:bu AS text) NOT IN ('ALM','BKR','EBO','GPC','OAD','ODR','OG2','OGP','SPC','STG','TSY','USG') OR lower(b.subportfolio) NOT LIKE 'conso%')) AS date_ok, (f.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_fy, CASE WHEN s.maturity_date < r.v_date OR (UPPER(CAST(:bu AS text)) IN ('PF6','PF9','QF1','QF2','RBA','RBC','RBH') AND b.reset_status IS NOT NULL AND b.reset_date <= r.v_date) OR (b.netting_status = 'fully_netted' AND b.netting_date <= r.v_date) OR (s.derivative_type ILIKE '%out%' AND COALESCE(br.b1, 0) <> 0) OR ((UPPER(CAST(:bu AS text)) NOT IN ('PF6','PF9','QF1','QF2','RBA','RBC','RBH') OR b.reset_status IS NULL OR b.reset_date > r.v_date) AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR (b.netting_status = 'fully_netted' AND b.netting_date > r.v_date) OR (r.v_date <= s.maturity_date AND b.netting_status IN ('not_netted','partially_netted') AND (s.derivative_type NOT ILIKE '%out%' OR COALESCE(br.b1, 0) = 0)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS classified, (sn.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS in_snapshot FROM base b CROSS JOIN run r LEFT JOIN lal l ON l.trade_id = b.trade_id LEFT JOIN fy f ON f.trade_id = b.trade_id LEFT JOIN sec s ON s.security_id = b.security_id LEFT JOIN bar br ON br.security_id = b.security_id LEFT JOIN snap sn ON sn.trade_id = b.trade_id ) SELECT count(*) AS s2_latest_version_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_lal) AS s3_active_lot_row, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_lal AND date_ok) AS s4_transaction_before_value_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_lal AND date_ok AND has_fy) AS s5_premium_fy_row, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_lal AND date_ok AND has_fy AND classified = 1) AS s6_live_or_dead_rule, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_snapshot) AS s7_in_snapshot, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_lal AND date_ok AND has_fy AND classified = 1 AND NOT in_snapshot) AS rule_says_yes_snapshot_missing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_snapshot AND NOT (in_lal AND date_ok AND has_fy AND classified = 1)) AS snapshot_has_more_than_rule FROM t

SELECT DISTINCT c.trade_id::text AS trade_id, CASE WHEN c.trade_id::text LIKE 'NET-%' THEN 'NET-' WHEN c.trade_id::text LIKE 'DUP-%' THEN 'DUP-' ELSE 'normal' END AS trade_kind, c.netting_status, c.portfolio FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu

stage.reason: every trade_id in cloned_deal_ticket_table for the BU (all versions)
latest version only: is_latest_version = 1 (what the recon reads)
has a row in latest_active_lot (latest active lots as of the valuation date, zero lots included)
transaction_date is before the run value date (and not a consolidation sub-portfolio for the BUs that exclude them)
has a premium_fy_table row for the valuation financial year
survives the recon deal-status rule (maturity, netting, reset, barrier): the rule that decides which deals are written
trades really in the published settle snapshot (BU suffix removed)

expect.reason: the settle snapshot of the date must be published by exactly one refresh run
every trade the recon rules should write is in the snapshot: nothing is lost
the snapshot holds no trade that the rules would not write: nothing extra
